verdict.rationale: Shopify documents officially supported SDKs/libraries (Admin GraphQL API, Storefront API), a first-party CLI, and AI-specific tooling like the AI Toolkit and UCP CLI, backed by runtime probes confirming live MCP/UCP endpoints and working CLI installs. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarks of SDK quality, and community feedback specifically criticizes API documentation/design (partner support complaints), leaving a minor quality gap.
